headline: TGP Reports Natural Gas Pipeline Leak at Camisea Field in Ayacucho
summary: Transportadora de Gas del Perú reported a leak on its Camisea pipeline in Ayacucho, scheduling three hours of venting operations under monitoring by energy regulator Osinergmin.
why: The Camisea pipeline transports the bulk of Peru's natural gas for domestic power generation, industrial use, and LNG export.
